description: Assess the repository’s structure and key project files (README, package/build configurations, lint/test configurations, and main entrypoints) to identify exactly one small maintainability defect. Document the precise location (file path + relevant snippet/line range) and propose a concrete fix with a clear rationale.
constraints: Limit scope to a single small maintainability defect (not a broad refactor).
Only inspect repository structure and key files: README, package/build configs, lint/test configs, and main entrypoints.
Do not execute code or perform destructive actions; analysis-only.
Proposed fix must be concrete (specific change to make) and justified (why it improves maintainability).
Output must include where the defect occurs (path + snippet/line range) and how to verify the fix.
acceptance_criteria: One maintainability defect is identified and described unambiguously.
The defect’s location is provided as a specific file path and a quoted snippet or line range.
A specific, minimal fix is proposed (exact edits or configuration changes).
Rationale explains the maintainability impact and why the fix is appropriate.
Verification steps are provided to confirm the fix resolves the issue without regressions (e.g., build/lint/test commands).
allowed_tools: Reading file contents of README, package/build config files, lint/test configs, and main entrypoints
